answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing tasks that counterparties verify and by posting a bond that is slashed when a dispute reveals fraud. Because one operator can create many identities but cannot cheaply multiply trustworthy, independently checked work, sybils must either build separate histories or risk losing capital on each account. A velvet interface, jade badge, or juniper-themed profile earns no extra weight: reputation comes from costly, verifiable commitments, so the attack scales with the attacker’s bonds and effort.
